answer: WITH x AS (SELECT c.c0002 seg, c.c0000 id, SUM(y.c0000) tot FROM t0004 c JOIN t0003 y ON y.c0001=c.c0000 WHERE c.c0001='CZK' AND substr(y.c0002,1,4)='2013' GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT seg,id,tot,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seg ORDER BY tot,id) rn FROM x), m AS (SELECT seg,tot FROM r WHERE rn=1) SELECT ROUND((SELECT tot FROM m WHERE seg='SME')-(SELECT tot FROM m WHERE seg='LAM'),2) AS sme_minus_lam, ROUND((SELECT tot FROM m WHERE seg='LAM')-(SELECT tot FROM m WHERE seg='KAM'),2) AS lam_minus_kam, ROUND((SELECT tot FROM m WHERE seg='KAM')-(SELECT tot FROM m WHERE seg='SME'),2) AS kam_minus_sme

SELECT CAST((julianday(MAX(t.c0004||' '||t.c0006))-julianday(MIN(t.c0004||' '||t.c0006)))*1440 AS INTEGER) FROM t0001 t JOIN t0002 s ON s.c0003=t.c0001 WHERE s.c0001='CZE' AND t.c0000>1000
